levels.surface: أبو حامد عمران بن موسى بن إبراهيم

notes: The leading 18 - number and the formulae رضي الله عنه and عليه السلام are left out.
أخيه + name is one link, its surface the name alone (rule 7).
سألت الرضا: the asker is the transmitter before, and the Imam asked is the last link (owner ruling 2).
قال مصنف after the saying is the author's commentary, not a route.
